subject: assets
title: Fidelity T3: the benchmark set, detailed stylised
note: The five Fidelity benchmark subjects at T0, T1 and T3 side by side in the stage world through the studio's shots (close-up, gameplay, worst light) plus T3's indirect light. New since the T0/T1 sheet: SDF-sculpted runestone carving, gnarled trunk and skeleton bones, normal-mapped texture graphs (stone, wood, rusted iron, bone, bark, leaves), moss/lichen/grime decals, particle flame, embers, motes and falling leaves, the lantern's point light and baked GI (tier low on the iGPU). Each T3 subject adds 0.1-0.7 ms of iGPU time in play at 720p.

images.caption: The T3 sheet: T0/T1/T3 per subject, three studio shots, indirect light, budget lines
T3 lantern: rusted iron, particle flame, its light warming the walls (GI baked)
T3 runestone: SDF-carved glowing runes, normal-mapped stone, moss and lichen decals
T3 tree from the game camera: sculpted trunk and crown, drifting leaves, moss decal
